title: Regiment and Compass
author: Lena Brightwater
blurb: Bram Montrose, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
